directive.quote: Make a dedicated proof key through Resend's API (the held key by handle only), held under its own name.

preserve: each reply field the row names by its dot path is kept in the account's vault and replaced in the reply by the secret marker
nothing is sent when the run has nowhere to keep what the reply carries
an empty or missing field is skipped, never kept
allowed_deltas: the kept name may come from the row (secret_name) or from the run's input (secret_name_from_input) as well as a connection field (keep_as_field)
a name already held is never replaced: nothing is sent when the reply would replace one
kept values are scrubbed from every text of the reply, not only their own field
the run's identity carries what it keeps, only when it keeps something
banned_substitutions: a kept value in the reply, a log, an argument or a file
replacing a value already held under the same name
